targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp as time,
  CASE
    WHEN value = '0' OR value = 'IDLE' THEN 'IDLE'
    WHEN value = '1' OR value = 'SETUP' THEN 'SETUP'
    WHEN value = '2' OR value = 'RUNNING' THEN 'RUNNING'
    WHEN value = '3' OR value = 'PLANNED STOP' THEN 'PLANNED STOP'
    WHEN value = '4' OR value = 'UNPLANNED STOP' THEN 'UNPLANNED STOP'
    WHEN value = 'MAINTENANCE' THEN 'MAINTENANCE'
    ELSE value
  END as state
FROM tag_string
WHERE asset_id = ${asset_id}
  AND name = 'state'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT NOW() as time,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - start_time))::int, 0) as duration_seconds
FROM machine_stops
WHERE asset_id = ${asset_id}
  AND end_time IS NULL
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  COALESCE(po.order_id, 'No Active Order') as "Current Order",
  COALESCE(po.part_number, '-') as "Part",
  po.quantity_completed::text || ' / ' || po.quantity::text as "Progress"
FROM production_orders po
JOIN asset a ON a.id = po.asset_id
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}'
  AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND a.line = '${line:raw}'
  AND po.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'RELEASED', 'CREATED')
ORDER BY po.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value, metric FROM get_state_timeline('${enterprise}', '${site}', 'shopfloor', '${line:raw}', '${workcell}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz)

SELECT ms.id, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, a.workcell
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON a.id = ms.asset_id
JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND a.line = '${line:raw}'
  AND a.workcell = '${workcell}'
  AND sr.name = 'Unspecified'
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ms.start_time ASC
SELECT id, name FROM stop_reasons WHERE name != 'Unspecified' ORDER BY name

SELECT ms.id, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, sr.name as reason
FROM machine_stops ms
JOIN asset a ON a.id = ms.asset_id
JOIN stop_reasons sr ON ms.stop_reason_id = sr.id
WHERE a.enterprise = '${enterprise}' AND a.site = '${site}'
  AND a.line = '${line:raw}'
  AND a.workcell = '${workcell}'
  AND sr.name != 'Unspecified'
  AND ms.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ms.start_time ASC
